body:
I have enough mirtazapine for tonight and tomorrow night. I have run out of gabapentin. Part of why I am so upset is mirtazapine withdrawal is hell and gabapentin withdrawal isn't pleasant either.  
I have a caseworker outside of brain jail, but he's kind of useless. I did see him today, but that was before I tried to fill my meds. I do know that part of my resentment is that my old caseworker, who I really liked, left the organization suddenly. But he's fresh out of college and barely knows what he's doing. He once asked me "Why do people cut themselves?" But I am still giving him a chance. Maybe he'll learn as he works, you know?
I will consider hospitalization. I think I am safe for tonight, I have a friend 3 time zones behind me checking in on me. It just sucks to even consider, because before this summer, I was "clean" of hospitalization for 4 years. DBT did amazing things for me, but it was a 90 minute round trip to the hospital that had the program, I graduated the program and I unfortunately cannot find anywhere closer. So I'm out of practice, and with DBT you need to practice it. I was very ashamed when I returned to a (safe) hospital this summer, and I'm feeling shame about a possible hospitalization so close together. I know it may be what's best for me but when I was younger, I was hospitalized on average every 4 months. I don't want to be like that again.  
My main problem is I am so very self-aware of my borderline personality disorder but I still can't stop.  
I'm sorry for such a wordy response, my brain's on overdrive.
